points.title: Five endings, three groups
points.rule: The chunks from earlier days now show a pattern. Trabajo, como, and vivo use the same endings as hablar, comer, and vivir. Say only yo, tú, él or ella, nosotros, and ellos or ellas. The subject pronoun is optional. A question does not add “do”. Tengo, quiero, voy, and hago stay chunks. They do not follow this pattern.

grammar.notYet: Vosotros, and stem-changing verbs. Tengo, quiero, voy, and hago stay chunks.

phrases.english: I eat fruit in the morning.
phrases.note: The same como as como a la una on day 9.
This is the day 6 chunk, now part of the -ir pattern.

phrases.english: I work, you work, he/she works.

lines.speaker: Nico
lines.english: Do you speak Spanish every day?

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.spanish: Sí. Estudio por la mañana y hablo por la noche.
lines.english: Yes. I study in the morning and speak at night.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.spanish: Vivo en Londres. Trabajo desde casa.
lines.english: I live in London. I work from home.

lines.speaker: Nico
lines.spanish: Nosotros también estudiamos. Bebemos café y practicamos.
lines.english: We also study. We drink coffee and practise.

practice.title: Three verbs, full pattern
practice.instruction: Pick hablar, comer, and vivir. Say yo, tú, él, nosotros, and ellos, then one sentence for each verb. Keep tengo, quiero, voy, and hago as chunks if you need them.
tips: -er: o, es, e, emos, en. -ir: o, es, e, imos, en.
